title: Strip the last 137 constant Javadocs (ConstantJavadoc rule; finishes IX-21)
description: IX-21 landed with 137 ConstantJavadoc violations left in ixdar-app: StripConstantJavadocRecipe's OpenRewrite parser failed on 39 files and skipped them. Until these are gone, every build with checkstyle on fails, including wt done for every worktree. Delete the /** ... */ block above each listed constant. Change nothing else; keep a source citation (URL, paper, license) as a single // line.
definition-of-done: 1. mvn -q compile -pl annotations,ixdar-app with checkstyle ON exits 0. 2. The unit suite passes. 3. Only Javadoc blocks on constants are removed; no code changes.
testing-plan: 1. checkstyle:check before and after (137 to 0). 2. mvn compile with checkstyle on. 3. mvn test.
